refnamediv.refpurpose: Upsample the signal by inserting zeros between elements.

refsynopsisdiv.title: Syntax
refsynopsisdiv.synopsis: y = upsample(x, n) y = upsample(x, n, phase)

listitem.para: Upsampling factor (positive integer). Specifies the number of samples in the upsampled signal for each input sample.
Offset specifying the position of the original sample in the block of `n` samples. Default is 0.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The `upsample` function increases the sampling rate of the input signal `x` by inserting `n-1` zeros between every element. If `x` is a matrix, the function upsamples every column independently. The optional `phase` parameter controls the position of the original sample in the block of `n` samples.
